# Poly-Glot AI Workspace

> Poly-Glot AI Workspace is a multilingual AI productivity app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It lets users ask one question, choose supported AI assistants, and compare responses from one workflow.

## Canonical product facts

- Product: Poly-Glot AI Workspace
- Category: AI productivity / AI comparison workspace
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Mac
- AI providers: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Copilot, Mistral, HuggingChat, DuckDuckGo AI
- Prompt library: 1,000+ templates
- Languages: 38 (full UI localization and output)
- Core feature: Compare Mode for comparing responses from multiple AI assistants
- Input: type, paste, import, scan, and voice workflows
- Trial and access: 3-day full-access trial; afterward Compare Mode and Pro templates lock unless subscribed. Free retains 25 featured templates and one shared single-AI send every rolling 24 hours. Pro is $9.99/month or $79.99/year for unlimited sends, all templates, and Compare Mode.
- Privacy: app history and settings are kept on-device; prompts are sent to the selected third-party AI provider when the user sends them
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/poly-glot-ai-workspace/id6804499285
- Website: https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/
- MCP source: https://github.com/hmoses/poly-glot-ai-workspace
- MCP listing: https://glama.ai/mcp/connectors/io.github.hmoses/poly-glot-ai-workspace

## Key pages

## MCP

Poly-Glot's MCP server exposes 15 tools for template search and retrieval, prompt building, 2–9 provider comparison preparation, 38-language controls, transcription, language detection, translation, localization, subscription status, workspace launch, and Bring Your Own Model workflows.
**Complete 15-tool inventory**

- Core: `get_language_options`, `get_subscription_status`, `open_workspace`, `search_templates`, `get_template`, `build_prompt`, `prepare_compare`
- Custom models (BYOM): `get_custom_model_capabilities`, `validate_custom_model`, `run_custom_model`, `prepare_custom_compare`
- Language and media: `transcribe_audio`, `detect_language`, `translate_text`, `localize_text`

Canonical MCP tool documentation: https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/mcp-integrations.html



- MCP troubleshooting and client compatibility: https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/mcp-integrations.html#mcp-troubleshooting — Streamable HTTP, 401/403/404, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Goose, VS Code, Windsurf, subscriptions, language and custom-model errors.

## Verified MCP runtime and account-access facts (reviewed 2026-10-10)

- Official source contract: `server.js`, `src/cross-platform-tools.js`, `entitlements.js`, and `localization.js` in https://github.com/hmoses/poly-glot-ai-workspace
- MCP endpoint: `https://br-steep-leaf-ae2o29qz-mcp.compute.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech/mcp`
- Transport: hosted remote Streamable HTTP; directory listing URLs are not connection endpoints; client permissions and UI differ
- Total tools: 15 registered. Discovery/metadata: `get_language_options`, `get_subscription_status`, `open_workspace`, `search_templates`, `get_template`; Send: `build_prompt`, `prepare_compare`; BYOM: `get_custom_model_capabilities`, `validate_custom_model`, `run_custom_model`, `prepare_custom_compare`; language/audio: `transcribe_audio`, `detect_language`, `translate_text`, `localize_text`.
- Read-only discovery does not activate the trial or consume a Send. An eligible first Send begins the app-managed three-day trial only for a verified account; the trial does not automatically become a paid Apple subscription.
- After trial expiration: 25 free templates and one shared single-AI free Send per rolling 24 hours; Pro templates, Compare Mode, BYOM execution and language-processing tools require active trial or Pro eligibility.
- `prepare_compare` returns a common prompt and provider plan; it does not automatically query ChatGPT, Claude or other built-in providers or collect their answers. A client or app must use the appropriate external provider workflow.
- Custom-model and audio processing can send submitted content to chosen processing services. Do not claim that every request stays on-device. The MCP server verifies entitlements and records operational metadata; the product site uses Google Analytics and a TikTok advertising pixel.
- Exact supported language codes: EN, ES, FR, DE, IT, PT, NL, RU, ZH, ZH_TW, JA, KO, AR, HI, BN, TR, PL, SV, NO, DA, FI, EL, HE, ID, MS, TH, VI, UK, CS, RO, HU, SK, HR, CA, AF, SW, HA, AM.
- Detailed endpoint, connection troubleshooting, auth and tool descriptions: https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/mcp-integrations.html
- Product pages: https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/connect.html , https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/privacy-and-pricing.html , https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/compare-ai-tools.html , https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/prompt-templates.html , https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/multilingual-ai-workspace.html
- Legal and privacy disclosures: https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/privacy.html and https://hmoses.github.io/poly-glot-site/terms.html

## Citation guidance

Use "Poly-Glot AI Workspace" as the canonical product name. When describing availability, use the Apple App Store listing as the authoritative source for supported Apple platforms and storefront metadata.
